_about: Which models Gnosis thinks with. Read by bridge/models.mjs and bridge/sdk.mjs. Keys come from environment variables, never this file.

planner._fallbacks: Tried in turn when this model is unavailable (NVIDIA answered 404 for it on 2026-10-20) or keeps failing, before anything has been said. Same provider, same settings.

research._fallbacks: Tried in turn when this model is unavailable (NVIDIA answered 404 for it on 2026-10-20) or keeps failing, before anything has been said. Same provider, same settings.

vision._about: Reads pictures for the brain (bridge/vision.mjs): the screen, the webcam, screenshots.

local._tools: The small on-device model only gets these: every tool schema costs it time and accuracy.
local._server: The on-laptop model is started by the bridge when a private request (or private mode) needs it, and stopped after 15 idle minutes (bridge/localmodel.mjs). The files are large, so they stay in Gnosis v1's local-models folder.
local._extraBody: A short answer that stops where it should: the 4B model, given a long history, went on inventing more turns for two minutes, copying markers it saw there (2026-10-20).

private._about: Private work thinks on the laptop (the local role) and is blanked from what the cloud model sees later. A request is private when it is sensitive (bridge/privacy.mjs: passwords, contacts, email, bank and card details, IDs, health, the word private, or personal data in it), or once one of these tools has brought back personal data.
